data.name: Hajiraan
data.gender_notes: Hajiraan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Makes a Pilgrimage
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hajiraan is derived from the verb ‘hajar’, which means ‘to make a pilgrimage’. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the journey to spiritual enlightenment and devotion to Allah. The name Hajiraan carries the meaning “The One Who Makes a Pilgrimage” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hajiraan usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who makes a pilgrimage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the spiritual journey to Allah and the Hajj pilgrimage.
data.etymology: Hajiraan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Makes a Pilgrimage.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hajiraan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حجيران
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحجيران: مصدر حجارة، بمعنى إقامة الحجارة، أو إقامة القبر. والمرأة الحجيرة: المرأة التي لا تملك مالًا، و لا تملك بيتًا، و لا تملك أباً. و هو لقب السيدة عائشة في كتاب السيرة النبوية. و هو اسم للفرد الذي يُقيم الحجارة، أو الذي يُقيم القبر.

in_english.name: Hajiraan
in_english.meaning: A woman who does not go for Hajj, a woman who is not married, a virgin, a woman who does not have a husband
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hajiraan is derived from the Arabic root H-J-R, which means to separate or to part. In Islamic tradition, a woman who does not go for Hajj is referred to as Hajiraan. This name is also associated with the virtue of being a virgin and being dedicated to one's faith. In modern times, the name Hajiraan is used to signify a woman who is strong in her faith and committed to her values.
